representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands manage × entity-hierarchy (many entities, high hierarchy, explicit status/attribution, zero-collateral batch ops). Initial screen is a 3-level tree table (site→system→unit→entity) with per-row status badge and full 归属路径 column (1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots: 华东·上海园区 0/70 → 动环监控系统 0/30 → 温度监测 12/12 → individual sensors), plus batch toolbar and selection inspector; app.js:4-13 declares the list-detail-inspector pattern and the visible-scope zero-collateral invariants.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Screenshots: the tree table occupies ~75% of the viewport; toolbar row 2 is entirely the batch task (对已选 N 项执行： 变更状态/移动归属/删除/全选可见/清除选择/撤销, app.js:384-399); right inspector is the selection set (选择集 0, app.js:698-747). Nothing unrelated to the primary job is on screen.

time_to_understand.evidence: Header/subtitle/badge state the job in one line (实体台账管理台 · 层级实体·批量操作台 · 可见即作用域·零误伤, app.js:353-358); panel caption explains the selection rule and inspector explains scope (screenshot; app.js:407, 709); footer totals orient instantly. Deduction: the 变更状态 button renders as a ~1-character-wide clipped sliver in both viewports, making one of the three batch commands illegible at first glance.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single page, zero modes: tree renders fully expanded on load (state.collapsed empty, app.js:97; screenshots show expanded hierarchy), search/filter/status tabs act in place (app.js:189-191), batch ops are one click from the persistent toolbar with an in-page modal (app.js:220-230). Primary object reachable in 0 steps.

context_loss.evidence: No route changes; confirmation modal shows the full affected list grouped by attribution path with counts before execution (app.js:855-908); focus is preserved across re-renders via roving tabindex restore (app.js:589-618); selection survives cancel (selftest.js:172); one-step undo restores entities and selection (app.js:272-339, selftest.js:146-152, 177-189).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces: header, two toolbar rows (search + 4 status tabs + scope counter; batch buttons), tree panel, inspector, status bar — each maps to a job need; no dead controls (search clear button appears only when has-value, styles.css:89-95; undo disabled until a receipt exists, app.js:460). Compact density (~30px rows, styles.css:23) matches the high-cardinality/high-density shape.

accessibility.evidence: measurement-summary.json:13-16 fails a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (3/7 pass, target_invalid:false). Source corroborates: 14px checkboxes (styles.css:223), 18px caret/remove icon buttons (styles.css:228, styles.css:291-295), secondary text in #8a97a5 at 10.5-11.5px (styles.css:14, 236-241, 253). Positives: treegrid roles, aria-level/aria-selected/aria-checked, per-checkbox aria-labels, :focus-visible outline (app.js:492-554, styles.css:40) — but the four automated failures dominate.

frontend_rework.evidence: Visible layout defect in both viewports: the 变更状态 button (app.js:387-389) is squeezed to a sliver with vertically stacked clipped glyphs between 对已选 0 项执行： and 移动归属 — layout.overflow and text.truncation checks passed, so this escaped automation but implies operator rework. Also selftest.js:93-95/151/184-187 asserts 160 entities while shipped data.js generates 164 (sum of unit counts; screenshot footer 实体总数 164)， so the built-in self-check is out of sync with the data. No invalid targets and no overflow/truncation failures (measurement-summary.json:12-14,18).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 批量选择与操作零误伤，状态归属显式 is addressed mechanically, not just cosmetically: group/select-all checkboxes operate only on currently rendered rows (app.js:201-216), collapsed/hidden entities cannot enter the selection set (selftest.js:102-114 asserts 0 selected from collapsed unit); every op passes a preview modal with per-path groups, affected count on the confirm button, and explicit 0-affected blocking (app.js:238-268, 842-845, 880-907); receipt lists 已影响 N 项 with per-item path→delta detail and one-step undo (app.js:296-320, 750-775); status column and full 归属路径 shown on every row and in the inspector (screenshots; app.js:526, 553).

defects_observed: 变更状态 toolbar button clipped to a ~1-char-wide vertical sliver in both 1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots (app.js:387-389) — batch status-change entry point is illegible

4 of 7 browser checks fail: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16); consistent with 14px checkboxes (styles.css:223), 18px icon buttons (styles.css:228,291-295), #8a97a5 secondary text (styles.css:14)
selftest.js:93-95,151,184-187 asserts entity total 160 while data.js and the rendered UI show 164 (screenshot footer 实体总数 164) — shipped self-check out of sync with data
collapse carets are tabindex=-1 + aria-hidden (app.js:510-513), reachable only indirectly through row keyboard handling; consistent with the a11y.focus_order failure
missing_evidence: sanitized measurement summary provides check ids and pass/fail only, not which specific elements failed the four a11y checks (scores above still citable via check ids and corroborating source lines)
scores.overall_note: The package matches the brief's shape almost exactly: a fully expanded hierarchical tree table with explicit status badges and attribution paths, scoped batch selection (visible-scope checkboxes, select-all-visible), preview-before-execute modals with per-path affected counts, receipts with per-item deltas, and one-step undo — the acceptance seed (zero-collateral batch ops, explicit status/attribution) is enforced in mechanics and verified by the bundled selftest scenarios (app.js:201-216, 238-320; selftest.js:102-189). Navigation and context costs are minimal (single screen, in-page modals, focus restoration), and the permanent surface set is tight. The main deductions are quality-control signals rather than concept errors: the 变更状态 button is visibly clipped in both operator screenshots, four of seven automated checks fail (all a11y/type-size related, corroborated by small targets and low-contrast secondary text in styles.css), and the shipped selftest asserts a 160-entity total that contradicts the 164 entities actually rendered — evidence of an unsynced verification layer. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot; the a11y failures in particular would need human/assistive-technology testing to translate into real user impact.
